role: Author: shared CPU admission reporter extraction and native preflight source reader; non-author bounded reading of parent/native producer only.

baseline.scope: Artifact preflight only. The runtime agent's existing-public 2F2P baseline is separate, not authored or independently reproduced in this report.

ownership.independent_scope: Read parent training/posthoc begin + READY/GO and native producer; no claim that author-reviewed own modules constitute independent acceptance.

contract.reporter: Fixed internal policy, never worker/config-selected. Original pre_script action ID, report phase, stable errors, message, terminal and claim-owned zero receipt remain unchanged. Artifact preflight additionally permits exact NOT_STARTED source only through the native cached verifier. Duplicate checks source, claim, FAILED fence and confirmed effects; stale returns no effects. No fixer or automatic recovery.
contract.source: Capture is detached/transient. Durable source contains attempt_ref, receipt_sha256, claim_attempt_id, claim_sha256, preflight_identity. Writer verification performs bounded metadata/stat/policy only; GO verification outside writer reuses the producer's nonblocking observed-size file reader. The old raw preflight claim hash is not imposed on legitimately updated started claim bytes.
contract.disabled: Absent/disabled preflight with no native history does not bind unrelated config or environment and needs no mandatory resolver. Native history cannot be erased by dropping config/caller wiring.
limits: Mutable input files are not globally locked or an immutable executable snapshot. Ordinary configured symlink/hardlink inputs retain producer semantics.
No large script/config hash runs under the SQLite writer. Optional check_inputs=False is accepted only inside the writer; default full verification is outside.
Same-process counter clearing/reprojection is not real process restart/adoption.
Only synthetic CPU scripts and temporary SQLite/filesystem; no accelerator, provider, real resolver, holdout or scientific qualification.
